summary: intake -> shaped -> bet -> in-flight -> verified -> landed -> learned, with parked and blocked beside it. A folder can never force a decision; a column can.

states.title: Intake
states.intent: A request as it arrived, in the words it arrived in. Nothing is promised here.

states.title: Shaped
states.intent: The problem, the appetite and the exit criterion are written down. This is the state a folder of proposals is really in -- and a state has an owner, an age and an exit.

states.title: Bet
states.intent: The owner has accepted this work. Nothing reaches this column without a human passing the door.

states.title: In flight
states.intent: Being built right now, inside the capacity this host declared.

states.title: Verified
states.intent: Evidence exists that the exit criterion is met. A claim of green is not green.

states.title: Landed
states.intent: In the trunk, reachable by everyone.

states.title: Learned
states.intent: What this taught is recorded where it will be read, or it was not learned.

states.title: Parked
states.intent: Deliberately not now, said out loud. An honest declared state, never a silent drawer.

states.title: Blocked
states.intent: Waiting on something outside this board, named.

transitions.exit: the card states a problem, an appetite and the criterion that will end it
the owner has accepted this work into the cycle -- no machine may make this move
a pre-approved standard change that was written as a card anyway: its class computed, not claimed (ADR-025) -- a standard change needs no card at all, its commit is its record

a normal change (ADR-025): costly to undo but not irreversible, so it is assessed by its criteria and its owner's peers rather than bet by the owner -- the owner's door stands where consequence is irreversible
the work has started and the host had a free slot for it
evidence, not testimony: every criterion the card declares resolved to a proof that held, and the machine refuses the passage until they do

the change is in the trunk and reachable by everyone -- and so is everything decomposed out of it: every card hanging under this one, at any depth, has every criterion it declares resolved to a proof that held. A card that was broken into parts is read from its parts, so nothing lands by saying so while a piece of it is still open
what it taught is recorded where it will be read
the owner has said not now, out loud, with a reason
work stopped on purpose, and the board says so rather than showing it as active
the card is shaped again against what has changed since it was parked
the thing being waited on is named on the card
what blocked it is gone, and the card says what it was
